items.title: Linux kernel (FIPS) vulnerabilities
items.summary: Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems: - x86 architecture; - Hardware monitoring drivers; - OCFS2 file system; - IPv4 networking; - Ethernet bridge; - Netfilter; - XFRM subsystem; (CVE-2025-21656, CVE-2026-63940, CVE-2026-74350, CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-99999)
items.affects: Ubuntu
items.action: Run apt update and apt upgrade, then reboot if the kernel changed.

items.title: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
items.summary: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.
items.affects: Linux Kernel
items.action: Update or mitigate as the vendor advises. CISA lists this flaw as exploited in attacks (deadline 2026-09-21 for US agencies).

items.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
items.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
items.affects: Linux Kernel
items.action: Update or mitigate as the vendor advises. CISA lists this flaw as exploited in attacks (deadline 2026-09-21 for US agencies).
